candidate.source_summary: The operation is triggered by a user accessing the URL pattern '^account/sessions/other/delete/$'. The view requires authentication via the LoginRequiredMixin, which ensures that only logged-in users can access this functionality. The session key comes from the current user's session cookie.
candidate.sink_summary: The operation results in deletion of all user sessions except the current one. It uses Django's DeletionMixin to perform the deletion, targeting Session objects in the database based on the user and excluding the current session key.
candidate.guard_summary: The view is protected by LoginRequiredMixin which ensures that only authenticated users can access this functionality. The operation filters sessions to only affect those belonging to the authenticated user, preventing cross-user session deletion. No additional input validation or sanitization is performed on the session key itself.
candidate.risk_pattern: The view allows a logged-in user to delete all their active sessions except the current one. While this is a legitimate administrative feature, it could be misused by an attacker who has gained access to a user's session to terminate other active sessions, potentially disrupting the user's access or forcing them to re-authenticate.
candidate.context_summary: This is a Django view that allows users to delete all their active sessions except the current one. It's part of a session management system where users can terminate other active sessions from different devices or locations. The implementation uses Django's built-in session management and authentication mechanisms.

target_cwe.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
target_cwe.description: The product uses external input to construct a pathname that is intended to identify a file or directory that is located underneath a restricted parent directory, but the product does not properly neutralize special elements within the pathname that can cause the pathname to resolve to a location that is outside of the restricted directory. Common in: path_traversal, input_validation.
target_cwe.impact: code execution, data access, data modification
remediation_steps: Validate and sanitize all file paths and names
Use canonical path resolution and access controls
